fields.subject: SQL Server Connection Settings
fields.where: a SqlConnectionConfiguration may have cached a resolved connection string and endpoint description
fields.trigger: one of its own (local) connection properties changes, a currently supplied ambient layer reports that one of its properties changed, or SetAmbientConfiguration supplies a new set of ambient layers
fields.response: discard both the previously resolved connection string and the cached ConnectionDescription; when SetAmbientConfiguration is called again, stop observing the previously supplied ambient layers before observing the new ones
fields.postcondition: the next connection-string or ConnectionDescription request resolves from the current local and ambient layer values, and changes to layers no longer supplied have no effect
